site.title: IAM — Writings
site.lede: Essays examining the structural conditions under which human judgment, continuity, and responsibility remain possible in environments increasingly shaped by automated and agentic systems.

audiences.general: Readers seeking orientation to continuity, judgment, and responsibility.
audiences.builders: System builders, researchers, and educators concerned with legibility and invariants.
audiences.foundations: Readers seeking philosophical foundations for time, judgment, and human agency.
audiences.agency: Readers concerned with how human agency erodes under delegation, automation, and optimization.
